browserWasmHost.transportNote: The browser's own JavaScript engine over Defold's WebAssembly memory. Hermes is not present.

dynamicHermesJsi.transportNote: Host functions installed on the Hermes runtime; reachable from interpreted bytecode and from AOT units.

luaStack.transportNote: Marshalling across the Defold Lua 5.1 stack inside the same engine process.

staticHermesCAbi.transportNote: $SHBuiltin.extern_c direct native calls. Emitted only by the Static Hermes C backend, so only AOT-compiled sound-typed units can issue them.
staticHermesCAbi.valueTransportNote: Defold value records cross as transparent fixed-layout copies whose element counts and ordering come from the pinned dmSDK layout report. Engine-owned values and Lua closures fail closed until the retained-handle and closure transports exist.

typescriptSdk.transportNote: Type-level projection only; not an execution runtime.
